process.h2: From Wire to Sorted Part, In-House

steps.title: Cold heading
steps.text: Multi-station cold headers form head and shank from wire in one pass, no material cut away.

steps.title: Thread rolling
steps.text: Threads are rolled, not cut, to tolerance 6g; the unbroken grain flow gives higher fatigue strength.

steps.title: Heat treatment
steps.text: Our mesh-belt furnace hardens and tempers to class 10.9 and 12.9. No outside heat treater.

steps.title: 100% optical sorting
steps.text: Every automotive part passes camera sorting for dimensional and surface defects before packing.

custom.h2: Custom Cold-Formed Parts to Your Drawing
custom.body: Send a STEP or PDF drawing. We review it for cold-heading feasibility, build the tooling and ship samples in 15 days. Cold heading first, secondary turning where the geometry needs it. One current part, a washer-faced special bolt in SCM435, runs at 2 million pieces a year. MOQ 100,000 pieces; first-order lead time 35–40 days.
